{{Top|leg}}
'''Supreme''' was a high-level [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]] within the Tof military. It was given to Tof commanders who oversaw an entire space fleet. During the [[Battle of Zeltros]] of the [[Nagai–Tof War]], an [[Unidentified Tof Supreme|unidentified Supreme]] commanded the Tof forces with help from the [[Wayfarer (Tof starship)|Wayfarer]].
